text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with a photoshoot to showcase her racewear approaching,
I was discussing the schedule with Nishino Flower when—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Ah.
I-I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, um,
I've been a little worried about the photo shoot..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon-san is also taking part in the upcoming photo session, so I asked her a bit yesterday about what kind of photos she's getting taken, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Replaced the background with CG, adjusting lighting
to match reflections in outer space.
Rendered effects tailored to the racing outfit's structure.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Create a sense of weightlessness through pose and camera angle.
Received 3D model samples from the client and structured patterns for the shoot day's plan.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: “—Thus, this represents the concept behind my racing racewear: 'A hyperspeed fighter jet streaking through the cosmos.'”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order: "Propose photo session plan"—
all stages completed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...!
That was such a wonderful plan...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Don't mention it.
I'll be glad if it proves helpful to you, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Bourbon-san put together an extremely
detailed plan for the shoot.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so passionate, I couldn't help
thinking how cool she was, but at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "...I guess I hadn't really thought as far ahead as concepts or anything like that."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was just so happy to be photographed in such a wonderful racing racewear... I was just enjoying myself...
choice_data_list: Then let's think about it together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list: I'm sure we'll figure something out if we talk it over.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes.
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spreading Nishino Flower's racing outfit design across the table,
she begins searching through it for anything
that could serve as a hint for the photoshoot plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And what came to my mind was—
choice_data_list: Let's focus on the use of color

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A motif...
In the case of my racing outfit... it would be flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to pour my yearnings and wishes into my racing outfit, and the first thing that came to mind were flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just like a bud blooming wonderfully one day...
I want to become a wonderful adult too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah―― I see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This is... these feelings are...
the concept behind my Racewear...!
In that case—
choice_data_list: Looks like you thought of something, huh.
Looks like you came up with something.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the photoshoot—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm! That's wonderful~!
Such a lovely, natural smile!
The flower motif goes perfectly with the bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That blooming smile is great too!
Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower created a field of flowers at the venue, successfully capturing full-bloomed smiles along with her heartfelt feelings—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The color scheme...
Um, the prominent color is yellow...
and then there's purple, right?
choice_data_list: Why did you choose this color scheme?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to pour everything that I am into my racing outfit, and I thought maybe I could express that through color.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I felt like yellow is a cheerful color. And this purple feels kinda mature... I put a part of who I want to become into each and every color—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah—
choice_data_list: Did you come up with something?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, just as an example...
how about taking a picture
with the bento...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought if we combined the colorful bento with my racing colors,
it would make a photo that captures my feelings
in even more colors—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Is it strange after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To me, it felt like an idea
that was very "her"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the photoshoot—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, Nishino Flower holding a bento box
in the early afternoon!
Even in your racing outfit, it looks picture-perfect~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the photoshoot began for Nishino Flower in her racewear,
setting out a colorful handmade bento—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I poured all my feelings into making this!
Please, take a photo with me!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! So colorful and vibrant...!
This will make a fine picture where your smiles truly shine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even the photographer gave their seal of approval, saying Nishino Flower's charm was on full display, successfully capturing her full-bloom smile—
